items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 25 September 2026 10:35pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 25 September 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at times.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland, cold front clearing southern Britain.


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 in the north of the area for a time overnight. Then becoming south or southwest 5 or 6 tomorrow evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate, then mainly moderate tomorrow evening.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, backing south or southeast Sunday morning. Perhaps increasing 7 at times on Sunday morning and afternoon. Then veering west by late afternoon, and then decreasing 3 or 4 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then rain Sunday morning and afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally poor in rain on Sunday.
